content: शपथः [शप्-अथन् <ls>Uṇ. 3. 112</ls>] .²1 Cursing. .²2 A curse, an imprecation, anathema. .²3 An oath, swearing, taking or administering an oath, asseveration by oath or ordeal; आमोदो न हि कस्तूर्याः शपथेनानुभाव्यते <ls>Bv. 1. 120</ls>; <ls>Ms. 8. 109</ls>. .²4 Conjuration, binding by oaths; सपदि शपथैः प्रत्यावृत्तिं प्रणम्य च याचते <ls>Māl. 3. 2</ls>.
